title: The Money Found on the Floor
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の機器の設計・運用手順、法令、実証結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A student notices some money on the floor of a shared study room just before leaving school.
sentences.ja: 生徒が下校直前に共用自習室の床にお金があることに気づく。

sentences.en: Nobody else is present, and the student cannot immediately identify the person who might have lost it.
sentences.ja: 他の人はおらず、落としたかもしれない人をすぐには特定できない。

sentences.en: She decides to report the discovery to a member of the school staff rather than simply leaving the money where she found it.
sentences.ja: お金を見つけた場所にそのまま置くのでなく、学校職員に発見を報告することにする。

sentences.en: Before doing so, she wonders how much information she should share in a message to the students who regularly use the room.
sentences.ja: そうする前にその部屋をよく使う生徒へのメッセージでどれほど情報を共有すべきか疑問に思う。

sentences.en: A friend suggests posting the exact amount of money and the location where it was discovered.
sentences.ja: 友人は金額と発見場所を正確に投稿するよう提案する。

sentences.en: Providing detailed information might help the person who lost the money recognize that the announcement concerns their property.
sentences.ja: 詳細情報を提供すると落とした人が通知は自分の所有物に関するものだと認識する助けになるかもしれない。

sentences.en: However, someone who did not lose the money could obtain the same information and use it to make a claim.
sentences.ja: しかしお金を落としていない人も同じ情報を得て所有を主張するために使える。

sentences.en: The students recognize that information useful for notifying a person may also be useful for someone attempting to misrepresent their relationship to the discovered item.
sentences.ja: 人に通知するのに有用な情報は発見品との関係を偽ろうとする人にも有用かもしれないと生徒は認識する。

sentences.en: They discuss the problem with the staff member, who explains that the school has a procedure for dealing with lost property.
sentences.ja: 職員と問題を相談すると学校には遺失物を扱う手順があると説明される。

sentences.en: The students consider a general notice directing anyone who has lost something to contact the appropriate office.
sentences.ja: 何かをなくした人に適切な事務室へ連絡するよう促す一般通知を考える。

sentences.en: A person making a claim could then be asked to provide relevant details according to the established procedure.
sentences.ja: 申し出た人は既定手順に従って関連詳細を提供するよう求められるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The fictional situation does not provide legal advice about actual lost property or determine how a particular institution should handle it.
sentences.ja: 架空状況は実際の遺失物の法的助言を提供せず特定機関の扱い方を決めるものでもない。

sentences.en: The students also recognize that a person might have difficulty remembering every detail of an item that they genuinely lost.
sentences.ja: 本当に落とした品の全詳細を思い出すのに苦労する人もいるかもしれないと生徒は認識する。

sentences.en: A verification procedure should therefore not be treated as a guarantee that every claim can be evaluated without any uncertainty.
sentences.ja: したがって確認手順をすべての申し出が不確実性なく評価できる保証と扱うべきではない。

sentences.en: Its purpose is to provide a reasonable way of examining claims while taking account of the interests of the people involved.
sentences.ja: 目的は関係者の利益を考慮しながら申し出を調べる合理的方法を提供することだ。

sentences.en: The students learn why an apparently simple act of assistance may require attention to the way information is distributed.
sentences.ja: 一見単純な援助にも情報配布方法への注意が必要になり得る理由を学ぶ。

sentences.en: Honest intentions are an important part of helping someone, but they do not automatically determine the most appropriate way to act.
sentences.ja: 正直な意図は誰かを助ける重要な部分だが最適な行動方法を自動的に決めるわけではない。

sentences.en: An action that makes information more widely available may have different consequences for different people.
sentences.ja: 情報をより広く利用可能にする行動は人によって異なる影響を持ち得る。

sentences.en: Responsible assistance involves considering those consequences and the practical arrangements through which a shared goal can be achieved.
sentences.ja: 責任ある援助には影響と共通目的を達成できる実務的手配の考慮が伴う。

sentences.en: The money found on the floor creates an opportunity to examine how good intentions can be translated into thoughtful action.
sentences.ja: 床で見つけたお金は善意を思慮深い行動に移す方法を吟味する機会を作る。

vocabulary.definition: statement claiming a right or fact
telling someone where or how to act
act of checking whether something is true
promise or assurance of a result

options: Some money on the floor of a shared study room.

questions.prompt: What does she decide to do first?
options: Report the discovery to school staff.
Leave it in the same place.

questions.prompt: What is a possible disadvantage of posting the exact details?
options: The actual owner would necessarily forget the amount.
A notice could never inform anyone.
The staff would no longer know where the money was found.
Someone could use the details to make a false claim.
questions.explanation_ja: 偽の申し出に使われる可能性。

questions.prompt: What information does the friend suggest publishing?

options: A general notice directing claimants to the appropriate office.
A notice containing all identifying details.
A demand that everyone claim the money.
A notice prohibiting contact with staff.

questions.prompt: Why involve a school staff member?
options: Students have no reason to report discoveries.
Staff always know the owner immediately.
An established process can help handle claims appropriately.
A fictional case establishes a legal duty.

questions.prompt: Why is accurate verification not guaranteed?
options: All owners deliberately lie about their property.
A genuine owner might not recall every detail.
No details can ever be used for verification.
questions.explanation_ja: 本当の所有者も詳細を忘れることがある。

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a reasonable procedure?
options: Ensure every claim is accepted without question.
Examine claims while considering the interests involved.
questions.explanation_ja: 関係者の利益を考慮し申し出を調べる。

questions.prompt: What does translated mean in the final sentence?
options: Expressed in a different national language only.

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the argument?
options: Helpful actions require considering how the distribution of information affects different people.
Every detail should always be published immediately.
Honest intentions guarantee that all actions are appropriate.
Lost property should never be reported.
questions.explanation_ja: 善意に加え情報の扱いを考える。

grammar.focus: rather than simply leaving the money
someone who did not lose the money
should therefore not be treated as a guarantee
through which a shared goal can be achieved
grammar.explanation_ja: 前置詞＋関係代名詞、受動態。

paraphrases.source: She decides to report the discovery to a member of the school staff rather than simply leaving the money where she found it.
paraphrases.rewrite: She chooses to report what she found instead of leaving it on the floor.

paraphrases.source: However, someone who did not lose the money could obtain the same information and use it to make a claim.
paraphrases.rewrite: A person unrelated to the loss might use the shared details to claim it.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 誤った申し出の可能性。

paraphrases.source: A verification procedure should therefore not be treated as a guarantee that every claim can be evaluated without any uncertainty.
paraphrases.rewrite: A verification process cannot be assumed to eliminate every uncertainty.

paraphrases.source: Responsible assistance involves considering those consequences and the practical arrangements through which a shared goal can be achieved.
paraphrases.rewrite: Thoughtful help considers the arrangements that enable people to achieve their goal.

discourse.role_ja: 詳細公開の利点とリスク。
記憶の限界と確認手順。
善意と適切な行動を区別。

cloze.explanation_ja: 発見品との関係を偽る。
